description: Ministry of Higher Education - Amendment  to the Gaz. Ex. No. 281/7, adding Dept. of Human Resource Management to the University of Ruhuna
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an Order made under Section 27(1) of the Act that amends the schedule establishing the University of Ruhuna by adding a new department. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on statutory authority, legal amendments, and regulatory changes to university governance structures rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
